name: jachin-desktop
description: Jachin-System Desktop Console - Tauri v2 + React + TypeScript

scripts.build: npm run ensure-json-no-bom && tsc && vite build
scripts.tauri:before-bundle: npm run ensure-l3-sidecar-for-bundle && npm run prepare-installer-payload && npm run ensure-updater-helper-sidecar
scripts.tauri:dev: npm run ensure-l3-sidecar-stub && npm run prepare-installer-payload && npm run ensure-json-no-bom && tauri dev
scripts.tauri:dev:with-updater: npm run ensure-l3-sidecar-stub && npm run prepare-installer-payload && npm run ensure-updater-helper && npm run ensure-json-no-bom && tauri dev
scripts.tauri:dev:fresh: npm run kill-port-dev && npm run tauri:dev
scripts.tauri:build:tts: npm run ensure-json-no-bom && tauri build --features tts-local
scripts.tauri:dev:tts: npm run ensure-l3-sidecar-stub && npm run prepare-installer-payload && npm run ensure-json-no-bom && tauri dev --features tts-local
scripts.tauri:dev:ambient: npm run ensure-l3-sidecar-stub && npm run prepare-installer-payload && npm run ensure-json-no-bom && tauri dev --features ambient
scripts.tauri:build:ambient: npm run ensure-json-no-bom && tauri build --features ambient
